name: meltdown
description: MELTDOWN — browser multiplayer FPS set in Neo-China, the city that forgets you.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run probe && npm run probe:look && npm run probe:net && npm run probe:arsenal && npm run probe:wake && npm run lint:fairness -- --quick && npm run probe:file && npm run probe:city && npm run probe:cityLife && npm run probe:mastery && npm run probe:identity && npm run probe:campaign && npm run probe:endgame && npm run lint:economy && npm run probe:economy && npm run probe:counter && npm run probe:crawl && npm run probe:ship && npm run probe:run && npm run probe:harden && npm run build && npm run smoke
scripts.certify:firmware: tsx -e "import(\"./shared/sim/ttk\").then(m=>{for(const r of m.certifyFirmwares()) console.log((r.ok?\"OK \":\"BAD\")+\" \"+r.firmware.padEnd(28)+r.seconds.toFixed(3)+\" s \"+r.shots+\" shots\")})"
scripts.deploy:workers: npx wrangler deploy && npx wrangler deploy -c wrangler.campaign.toml && npx wrangler deploy -c wrangler.counter.toml
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && npm run smoke && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name meltdown
